name: Solid

hook.title: Your Solid components run on day one.
hook.lede: `@pyreon/solid-compat` runs Solid's API on Pyreon: signals, memos, effects, stores, resources and the control-flow components. Solid and Pyreon already share the model, so the final move is mostly a change of signal shape.

doesNotCover: Fine-grained updates inside compat components: a setter re-runs the whole component body (output and lifecycle stay correct). Converted Pyreon components get per-node updates back.
Mutable stores (`createMutable`, `modifyMutable`), `onError` and `isServer`: not exported, so an import fails loudly.
Solid's SSR entry points (`renderToString`, `renderToStream`, `HydrationScript`, `NoHydration`, `Assets`): use Pyreon's own SSR.
`dom-expressions` helpers (`template`, `insert`, `spread`, `classList`, `delegateEvents`): Pyreon's compiler replaces Solid's Babel plugin.

config.note: Use it in place of `vite-plugin-solid`. Aliases `solid-js` and its JSX runtime.
As given in the package README.

ports.title: Then, one component at a time

before.label: Solid (runs as-is on solid-compat)

after.label: Pyreon

ports.note: The read stays `count()`; the write moves from `setCount` to `count.set` / `count.update`. Lists change from `<For each={rows()}>` to `<For each={rows} by={(r) => r.id}>`.
